'''Juda's mother''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. She had a daughter [[Juda]] who worked for [[Suudaa Nem'ro]] in his palace on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Hutta]] and sent her mother some of the money she earned.<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic" />

==Behind the scenes==
Juda's mother is briefly mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in a letter that Juda sends to the Bounty Hunter player character.<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic" />
